Lina (partnerships): quick pre-ship check — can we confirm who is green on sandbox creds, final hero copy, and legal signoff? embargo window needs to be locked.
Dan (marketing): im on hero copy. i'll post two variants (partner-first + neutral fallback) by 11:30am PT.
Noor (product): staging is live at staging.redwood.com/marketplace-beta. one integration diagram missing (partner sysdiagram.svg). need by 10:45am or i'll swap placeholder.
Jay (solutions): SI dry run can happen tomorrow 10am PT. need sandbox creds + endpoint URL from partner today. otherwise we go with recorded demo.
Priya (legal): flag: any partner quotes must be signed off. if we get none, use company quote only. embargo ok but we need exact timestamp for clause.
Lina (partnerships): embargo set Thurs 09:00am PT. partners must confirm assets & quotes by Wed 5pm PT. fallback path: neutral CTA + product quote.
Dan (marketing): noted. i'll prepare fallback CTAs and an image that doesn't use partner logo.
Noor (product): small QA note: when svg missing the layout shifts on mobile. i'll add a CSS placeholder so layout stable.
Jay (solutions): pinged partner (SI team) — they said creds might take till 3pm. @Lina can you escalate?
Lina (partnerships): escalating now to partner PM.
deploy-bot: created ticket RED-MKT-2024: "Marketplace embargo & SI readiness" assigned to Dan/Noor/Jay, due 2024-07-24 17:00 PT. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-MKT-2024
Dan (marketing): draft hero variants: 
```
Variant A: "Partnering to bring scalable inference to production."
Variant B: "Ship production-ready LLM inference with Redwood."
```
Posting in thread for feedback.
Priya (legal): prefer Variant B, but suggest replacing "production-ready" with "production-grade". also need benchmark link removal unless we have a citation.
Dan (marketing): updated. new hero posted.
Noor (product): added placeholder CSS patch, will deploy to staging in 15m.
Jay (solutions): partner sent partial creds (token + staging URL) at 1765554400. standing up sandbox now.
Lina (partnerships): summary checklist (copying):
- Embargo: Thurs 09:00am PT
- Assets due: Wed 17:00 PT (logo SVG, sysdiagram)
- Quotes signed: Wed 17:00 PT
- Hero copy: Dan -> 11:30am PT
- SI dry run: Jay -> tomorrow 10am PT (or recorded demo)
- Ship ticket: RED-MKT-2024

If any owner misses the deadline we default to fallback messaging and recording. escalate issues here.
Dan (marketing): LGTM. i'll also upload a fallback screenshot to the CMS.
Priya (legal): will review any posted quote asap. please ping in-thread when partner posts approvals.
Jay (solutions): sandbox up at 1765554560, connecting to staging. runbook link: https://drive.redwood.com/si/runbooks/marketplace-sandbox-v2.md
Lina (partnerships): thanks all. reconvene 45m before embargo for final check. :bell:
